projection: uncentered P*x; stored FP64 rows certified contractive by exact rational Gram infinity norm; common scaling (1-2^-40)

score_contract: unchanged ordered RN-FP64 squared L2, FMA disabled, original full-path native bound and U*

metadata: signed outward FP32 lo/hi pairs, zero padding, 16-byte alignment, level-local only
